 SK Hynix , US78392B1070 SK Hynix stock: At EUR 866.00, SK Hynix stock rises 5.61 percent
 Published on 10/19/2026 at 15:58 | Editorial responsibility: Rafael Müller, Editor-in-Chief AD HOC NEWS 
 SK Hynix stock costs EUR 866.00 on October 19, 2026, up 5.61 percent versus the Xetra close. Results follow October 28. 
 Stock rises in afternoon trading
 The October 19, 2026 session sent SK Hynix stock 5.61 percent higher.
 SK hynix is scheduled to report third-quarter results on October 28, 2026.
 SK Hynix stock costs EUR 866.00 at Lang & Schwarz on October 19, 2026 at 3:40 p.m. CEST, 5.61 percent above the Xetra close of October 16, 2026.
 Fifteen brokerages averaged a USD 253.22 target on October 18, 2026.
 SK Hynix, US78392B1070, Illustration mit AI erstellt. 
 SK Hynix stock rose 5.61 percent in the euro session on October 19, 2026, moving from the Xetra close of October 16, 2026 at EUR 820.00 to EUR 866.00. At Lang & Schwarz, the stock was trading at EUR 866.00 on October 19, 2026 at 3:40 p.m. CEST, up 5.61 percent versus the Xetra close.
 October 28 results set the next date
 SK hynix is scheduled to report its third-quarter 2026 results on October 28, 2026, according to Simply Wall St . The company is expected to publish the results at 9:00 a.m. Korea Standard Time, giving the upcoming report a clear calendar position.
 Price sits below the yearly high
 The euro quote reached a bid of EUR 864.00 and an ask of EUR 868.00 at the stated afternoon timestamp. The same session showed a high of EUR 878.00 and a low of EUR 842.00, while volume stood at 21,608 shares against an average of 46,560 shares.
 The 52-week range was EUR 282.00 to EUR 1,725.00 as of October 19, 2026. At EUR 866.00, the stock stood 49.80 percent below that high. The move therefore lifted the quotation materially within its annual range without placing it near the upper boundary.
 Valuation and analyst targets
 SK Hynix had a market capitalization of EUR 632.7 billion and a price-to-earnings ratio of 5.61 as of October 19, 2026. MarketBeat reported on October 18, 2026 that 15 brokerages held a consensus Buy rating and an average 12-month target of USD 253.22. The same report cited Chinese competition, possible memory oversupply and uncertainty around sustained artificial intelligence demand as risks.
 Comparison with peers
 SK Hynix (Xetra, EUR): plus 5.61 percent, P/E 5.61, market capitalization EUR 632.7 billion.
Micron Technology (Nasdaq, USD): plus 3.73 percent, P/E 12.34, market capitalization USD 1.0 trillion.
Samsung Electronics (Korea Exchange, KRW): plus 1.16 percent, P/E 9.69, market capitalization KRW 1,256.6 trillion.
 Price and investor calendar
 The next scheduled reporting date is October 28, 2026. For investors, the combination of a 5.61 percent session gain and a price-to-earnings ratio of 5.61 puts the upcoming results firmly alongside the daily quotation in the market calendar.
 Afternoon price snapshot
 SK Hynix stock was trading at EUR 866.00 at Lang & Schwarz on October 19, 2026 at 3:40 p.m. CEST, 5.61 percent above the Xetra close of October 16, 2026 at EUR 820.00.
 The further course of trading is shown by the continuously updated real-time quote of SK Hynix stock .
